posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Square adds ChatGPT and Claude integrations Finextra · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 5h ago • Square integrated ChatGPT and Claude to help sellers reach customers during purchasing moments via AI conversations. • The integrations aim to increase seller discovery and transaction completion through AI-powered chat. • Square is positioning AI assistants as tools to connect buyers and sellers at decision points. 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic says it cut 80 percent of Claude Code's system prompt because Fable 5 models "want a smaller system prompt" The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 10h ago • Anthropic reduced Claude Code's system prompt by 80 percent for Fable 5 models. • Newer models require fewer instructions and perform better with less guidance. • Anthropic found that extensive prompts can constrain model capabilities.
